description:
Plendio compares prices on consumer products across online shops in Denmark, Sweden, Germany and Norway. Ask in plain language – "a laptop with 32 GB RAM under 12,000 kr." or "where is the Sony WH-1000XM5 cheapest in Sweden, including shipping?" – and get matching products, their specifications and price history, and the shops that sell them, cheapest first with shipping included.

Prices include VAT in the local currency (DKK, SEK, EUR, NOK), and by default only shops that deliver to your country are shown. Every result links to the product's page on Plendio, where all offers are listed. Questions can be asked in Danish, Swedish, German, Norwegian or English.

No sign-in needed and nothing is changed on your behalf: Plendio only reads its own product catalogue. There are no ads and no shop can pay for a better position. Plendio is run by PriceBot ApS, a registered secondary name of Codeful ApS (CVR 39453584), Denmark.
